title: bidens coreopsidis var. reptans
intro: Bidens coreopsidis var. reptans, commonly known as Creeping Beggar Lice, is a flowering plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. However, further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential applications of Bidens coreopsidis var. reptans in human health.
